item.title: Lady Gaga's '100 People In a Room' Speech Resurfaced On TikTok This Week
item.description: Gaga often used the line, "100 people could be in a room, and 99 don't believe in you, but just one person can change everything," to describe actor Bradley Cooper's support for her while filming A Star is Born in 2018.
